write_wav — ONED io op

• Data kinds: signal → file

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.write_wav(path, x, rate=44100) (to call the implementation directly, import dsp; dsp.write_wav(path, x, rate=44100); from the registry, ops1d.get("write_wav"))

Usage

Write a float `[-1,1]` mono signal to a 16-bit PCM WAV (stdlib). Non-finite samples raise (they would become garbage PCM).
